responsibility: Implements CRIS common option handling for early decoding of machine-selection switches into target flag state. The file applies the bit-level effects of options such as -metrax100 and the 8/16/32-bit alignment modes, combines them with CRIS subtarget defaults to form the default flag set, and leaves higher-level semantic consistency checks to later CRIS option-override code, making this file the low-level bridge from decoded options to normalized flag bits.
